== Notes ==
* Is useful between battles to build and maintain adrenaline and start the next battle with all adrenaline skills charged.
** [["I Am the Strongest"]] is good for this due to its incredibly long duration. 
* Has synergy with the [[Warrior]] Shout [["For Great Justice!"]].
